name: checkpoints
description: Per-task undo history. Snapshots the workspace into a shadow git repository before every file-mutating turn, so any point in a task can be diffed and restored without touching the workspace's own repository.
author: Shofer

initTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a task's shadow repository to initialize before giving up and disabling checkpoints for that task.

excludePatterns.description: Extra newline-separated .gitignore-style patterns to exclude from checkpoints, on top of the built-in build-artifact/media/cache/LFS patterns.
